en: Nothing gives them the right to establish these laws.
zh-Hant: 他們憑什麼訂這些法律。
zh-Hans: 他们凭什么定这些法律。
note: fn_description_composer 885282：價值觀看法

en: No law can do justice to the complexity of life.
zh-Hant: 沒有哪條法律能顧及人生的複雜。
zh-Hans: 没有哪条法律能顾及人生的复杂。
note: fn_description_composer 885286：價值觀看法

en: Some laws are just, while others were made to be broken.
zh-Hant: 有些法律是公正的，有些則生來就是要被打破的。
zh-Hans: 有些法律是公正的，有些则生来就是要被打破的。
note: fn_description_composer 885295：價值觀看法

en: Rules are there to be bent, but they shouldn't be flouted thoughtlessly.
zh-Hant: 規矩本來就可以通融，但也不該輕率地無視。
zh-Hans: 规矩本来就可以变通，但也不该轻率地无视。
note: fn_description_composer 885300：價值觀看法

en: I consider laws to be more of a suggestion than anything.
zh-Hant: 我覺得法律頂多只是個建議。
zh-Hans: 我觉得法律顶多只是个建议。
note: fn_description_composer 885305：價值觀看法

en: One should always respect the law.
note: fn_description_composer 885314：價值觀看法

en: Society flourishes when law breakers are punished.
zh-Hant: 違法者受到懲罰，社會才會興盛。
zh-Hans: 违法者受到惩罚，社会才会兴盛。
note: fn_description_composer 885318：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885330：價值觀看法；整句：Don't serve anyone blindly.  You'll only get into trouble.
fn_description_composer 885330：價值觀看法；整句：Don't serve anyone blindly.  You'll only get into trouble.

en: The whole idea of loyalty is pointless.
zh-Hant: 忠誠這種想法根本沒有意義。
zh-Hans: 忠诚这种想法根本没有意义。
note: fn_description_composer 885336：價值觀看法；整句：The whole idea of loyalty is pointless.  Acting purely out of loyalty implies acting against one's own best interest.

en: Acting purely out of loyalty implies acting against one's own best interest.
zh-Hant: 單純為了忠誠而行動，就等於違背自己的最大利益。
zh-Hans: 单纯为了忠诚而行动，就等于违背自己的最大利益。
note: fn_description_composer 885336：價值觀看法；整句：The whole idea of loyalty is pointless.  Acting purely out of loyalty implies acting against one's own best interest.
fn_description_composer 885342：價值觀看法；整句：Never lose yourself in loyalty.  You know what is best for yourself.

en: You know what is best for yourself.
zh-Hant: 什麼對你最好，你自己最清楚。
zh-Hans: 什么对你最好，你自己最清楚。
note: fn_description_composer 885342：價值觀看法；整句：Never lose yourself in loyalty.  You know what is best for yourself.

en: Loyalty has value, but you should always keep the broader picture in mind.
zh-Hant: 忠誠有它的價值，但你總得顧全大局。
zh-Hans: 忠诚有它的价值，但你总得顾全大局。
note: fn_description_composer 885353：價值觀看法

en: You should only maintain loyalty so long as something more important is not at stake.
zh-Hant: 只有在沒有更重要的事受到威脅時，才該維持忠誠。
zh-Hans: 只有在没有更重要的事受到威胁时，才该保持忠诚。
note: fn_description_composer 885359：價值觀看法

en: Consider your loyalties carefully, adhere to them while they last, and abandon them when you must.
zh-Hant: 謹慎選擇效忠的對象，還有效時就堅守，必要時就拋棄。
zh-Hans: 谨慎选择效忠的对象，还有效时就坚守，必要时就抛弃。
note: fn_description_composer 885365：價值觀看法

en: You must never forget true loyalty.
zh-Hant: 絕不能忘記真正的忠誠。
zh-Hans: 绝不能忘记真正的忠诚。
note: fn_description_composer 885376：價值觀看法；整句：You must never forget true loyalty.  Repay it in full.
fn_description_composer 885376：價值觀看法；整句：You must never forget true loyalty.  Repay it in full.

en: How can society function without loyalty?
zh-Hant: 沒有忠誠，社會要怎麼運作？
zh-Hans: 没有忠诚，社会要怎么运转？
note: fn_description_composer 885381：價值觀看法；整句：How can society function without loyalty?  We must be able to have faith in each other.

en: We must be able to have faith in each other.
zh-Hant: 我們必須能夠彼此信任。
zh-Hans: 我们必须能够彼此信任。
note: fn_description_composer 885381：價值觀看法；整句：How can society function without loyalty?  We must be able to have faith in each other.

en: One must always be loyal to their cause and the ones they serve.
zh-Hant: 人總要忠於自己的志業和效力的對象。
zh-Hans: 人总要忠于自己的事业和效力的对象。
note: fn_description_composer 885386：價值觀看法

en: I was always irritated by family.
note: fn_description_composer 885399：價值觀看法

en: We cannot choose our families, but we can choose to avoid them.
zh-Hant: 家人沒得選，但我們可以選擇躲開他們。
zh-Hans: 家人没得选，但我们可以选择躲开他们。
note: fn_description_composer 885403：價值觀看法

en: I hold the relationships I've forged myself over family ties I had no part in creating.
zh-Hant: 比起與生俱來的血緣，我更看重自己建立的關係。
zh-Hans: 比起与生俱来的血缘，我更看重自己建立的关系。
note: fn_description_composer 885409：價值觀看法

en: Family is complicated and those ties be both a boon and a curse.
zh-Hant: 家庭很複雜，這種羈絆可能是福也可能是禍。
zh-Hans: 家庭很复杂，这种羁绊可能是福也可能是祸。
note: fn_description_composer 885419：價值觀看法；整句：Family is complicated and those ties be both a boon and a curse.  Sometimes both at once!
fn_description_composer 885419：價值觀看法；整句：Family is complicated and those ties be both a boon and a curse.  Sometimes both at once!

en: You can't always rely on your family, but it's good to know somebody is there.
zh-Hant: 家人不一定靠得住，但知道有人在總是好的。
zh-Hans: 家人不一定靠得住，但知道有人在总是好的。
note: fn_description_composer 885425：價值觀看法

en: How great it is to be surrounded by family!
note: fn_description_composer 885436：價值觀看法

en: You can always rely on your family when everything else falls away.
zh-Hant: 當一切都離你而去，家人永遠靠得住。
zh-Hans: 当一切都离你而去，家人永远靠得住。
note: fn_description_composer 885440：價值觀看法

en: Family is the true bond that keeps society thriving.
zh-Hant: 家庭才是讓社會興旺的真正紐帶。
zh-Hans: 家庭才是让社会兴旺的真正纽带。
note: fn_description_composer 885445：價值觀看法

en: Friends are nice, but you should keep your priorities straight.
zh-Hant: 朋友是很好，但要分清輕重緩急。
zh-Hans: 朋友是很好，但要分清轻重缓急。
note: fn_description_composer 885453：價值觀看法

en: Be careful of your so-called friends.
zh-Hant: 小心你那些所謂的朋友。
zh-Hans: 小心你那些所谓的朋友。
note: fn_description_composer 885461：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885466：價值觀看法；整句：Friends are future enemies.  I don't see the difference.  People do as they must.
fn_description_composer 885466：價值觀看法；整句：Friends are future enemies.  I don't see the difference.  People do as they must.

zh-Hant: 人總是做不得不做的事。
zh-Hans: 人总是做不得不做的事。
note: fn_description_composer 885466：價值觀看法；整句：Friends are future enemies.  I don't see the difference.  People do as they must.
fn_description_composer 885472：價值觀看法；整句：Building friendships is a waste.  There is no bond that can withstand distance or a change of circumstance.

en: There is no bond that can withstand distance or a change of circumstance.
zh-Hant: 沒有哪種情誼禁得起距離或世事變遷。
zh-Hans: 没有哪种情谊经得起距离或世事变迁。
note: fn_description_composer 885472：價值觀看法；整句：Building friendships is a waste.  There is no bond that can withstand distance or a change of circumstance.

en: There's nothing like a good friend.
note: fn_description_composer 885482：價值觀看法

en: Surround yourself with friends you can trust and you will be unstoppable.
zh-Hant: 身邊都是信得過的朋友，你就所向無敵。
zh-Hans: 身边都是信得过的朋友，你就所向无敌。
note: fn_description_composer 885487：價值觀看法

en: When all other bonds wither, friendship will remain.
zh-Hant: 其他羈絆都枯萎時，友誼依然長存。
zh-Hans: 其他羁绊都枯萎时，友谊依然长存。
note: fn_description_composer 885492：價值觀看法

en: The struggle for power must be balanced by other considerations.
zh-Hant: 爭權奪勢也得顧及其他事情。
zh-Hans: 争权夺势也得顾及其他事情。
note: fn_description_composer 885500：價值觀看法

en: There's nothing admirable about bullying others.
zh-Hant: 欺負別人沒什麼了不起的。
zh-Hans: 欺负别人没什么了不起的。
note: fn_description_composer 885507：價值觀看法

en: It is abhorrent to seek power over other people.
zh-Hant: 追求凌駕他人的權力真令人厭惡。
zh-Hans: 追求凌驾他人的权力真令人厌恶。
note: fn_description_composer 885511：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885520：價值觀看法

en: Power over others is the only true measure of worth.
zh-Hant: 支配他人的權力才是衡量價值的唯一標準。
zh-Hans: 支配他人的权力才是衡量价值的唯一标准。
note: fn_description_composer 885524：價值觀看法

en: You can be powerful or powerless.
zh-Hant: 你可以有權有勢，也可以無權無勢。
zh-Hans: 你可以有权有势，也可以无权无势。
note: fn_description_composer 885529：價值觀看法；整句：You can be powerful or powerless.  The choice is yours, until somebody makes it for you.

en: The choice is yours, until somebody makes it for you.
zh-Hant: 選擇在你，直到有人替你做決定為止。
zh-Hans: 选择在你，直到有人替你做决定为止。
note: fn_description_composer 885529：價值觀看法；整句：You can be powerful or powerless.  The choice is yours, until somebody makes it for you.

en: There is no value in telling the truth thoughtlessly.
zh-Hant: 不經思考就說實話，一點價值也沒有。
zh-Hans: 不经思考就说实话，一点价值也没有。
note: fn_description_composer 885543：價值觀看法；整句：There is no value in telling the truth thoughtlessly.  Consider the circumstances and say what is best.

en: Consider the circumstances and say what is best.
zh-Hant: 看清情況，說最恰當的話。
zh-Hans: 看清情况，说最恰当的话。
note: fn_description_composer 885543：價值觀看法；整句：There is no value in telling the truth thoughtlessly.  Consider the circumstances and say what is best.

en: Is there ever a time when honesty by itself overrides other considerations?
zh-Hant: 難道會有誠實本身比其他考量更重要的時候嗎？
zh-Hans: 难道会有诚实本身比其他考量更重要的时候吗？
note: fn_description_composer 885549：價值觀看法；整句：Is there ever a time when honesty by itself overrides other considerations?  Say what is right, not what is true.

en: Say what is right, not what is true.
zh-Hant: 說該說的話，而不是真話。
zh-Hans: 说该说的话，而不是真话。
note: fn_description_composer 885549：價值觀看法；整句：Is there ever a time when honesty by itself overrides other considerations?  Say what is right, not what is true.

en: Don't think about the truth, whatever that is.
zh-Hant: 別去想什麼真相，管它是什麼。
zh-Hans: 别去想什么真相，管它是什么。
note: fn_description_composer 885555：價值觀看法；整句：Don't think about the truth, whatever that is.  Just say what needs to be said.

en: Just say what needs to be said.
note: fn_description_composer 885555：價值觀看法；整句：Don't think about the truth, whatever that is.  Just say what needs to be said.

en: There are times when it is alright not to tell the whole truth.
zh-Hant: 有時候不把實話全說出來也無妨。
zh-Hans: 有时候不把实话全说出来也无妨。
note: fn_description_composer 885565：價值觀看法

en: It is best not to complicate your life with lies, sure, but the truth also has its problems.
zh-Hant: 當然，最好別用謊言把生活搞複雜，但說實話也有它的麻煩。
zh-Hans: 当然，最好别用谎言把生活搞复杂，但说实话也有它的麻烦。
note: fn_description_composer 885571：價值觀看法

en: Sometimes the blunt truth just does more damage.
zh-Hant: 有時候直話直說反而傷害更大。
zh-Hans: 有时候直话直说反而伤害更大。
note: fn_description_composer 885577：價值觀看法；整句：Sometimes the blunt truth just does more damage.  Think about how the situation will unfold before you speak.

en: Think about how the situation will unfold before you speak.
zh-Hant: 開口之前，先想想事情會怎麼發展。
zh-Hans: 开口之前，先想想事情会怎么发展。
note: fn_description_composer 885577：價值觀看法；整句：Sometimes the blunt truth just does more damage.  Think about how the situation will unfold before you speak.

en: You should always tell the truth.
note: fn_description_composer 885588：價值觀看法

en: There is nothing so important that it is worth telling a lie.
zh-Hant: 沒有什麼事重要到值得說謊。
zh-Hans: 没有什么事重要到值得说谎。
note: fn_description_composer 885592：價值觀看法

en: Everything is so much easier when you just tell the truth.
zh-Hant: 只要說實話，一切都簡單多了。
zh-Hans: 只要说实话，一切都简单多了。
note: fn_description_composer 885596：價值觀看法

en: I do admire a clever trap.
zh-Hant: 我真的很欣賞巧妙的陷阱。
zh-Hans: 我真的很欣赏巧妙的陷阱。
note: fn_description_composer 885603：價值觀看法

en: Be shrewd, but do not lose yourself in guile.
zh-Hant: 要精明，但別陷在詭計裡迷失自己。
zh-Hans: 要精明，但别陷在诡计里迷失自己。
note: fn_description_composer 885607：價值觀看法

en: There's no value in all of this scheming I see these days.
zh-Hant: 最近看到的這些勾心鬥角，一點價值也沒有。
zh-Hans: 最近看到的这些勾心斗角，一点价值也没有。
note: fn_description_composer 885610：價值觀看法

en: There is a time for artful speech, and a time for blunt speech as well.
zh-Hant: 有時該說得委婉，有時也該直說。
zh-Hans: 有时该说得委婉，有时也该直说。
note: fn_description_composer 885616：價值觀看法

en: Who are these mealy-mouthed cowards trying to impress?
zh-Hant: 這些說話拐彎抹角的懦夫想討好誰啊？
zh-Hans: 这些说话拐弯抹角的懦夫想讨好谁啊？
note: fn_description_composer 885623：價值觀看法

en: They are so full of all those big words.
zh-Hant: 他們滿口都是那些文謅謅的詞。
zh-Hans: 他们满口都是那些文绉绉的词。
note: fn_description_composer 885627：價值觀看法

en: I do admire a clever turn of phrase.
note: fn_description_composer 885635：價值觀看法

en: I can appreciate the right turn of phrase.
zh-Hant: 說得恰到好處的話，我懂得欣賞。
zh-Hans: 说得恰到好处的话，我懂得欣赏。
note: fn_description_composer 885639：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885646：價值觀看法

en: Life isn't fair, and sometimes you have to do what you have to do, but working toward a balance isn't a bad thing.
zh-Hant: 人生本來就不公平，有時候不得不做該做的事，但努力求取平衡也不是壞事。
zh-Hans: 人生本来就不公平，有时候不得不做该做的事，但努力求得平衡也不是坏事。
note: fn_description_composer 885651：價值觀看法

en: Don't be afraid to do anything to get ahead in this world.
zh-Hant: 在這世上想出頭，就別怕不擇手段。
zh-Hans: 在这世上想出头，就别怕不择手段。
note: fn_description_composer 885655：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885659：價值觀看法

en: I can see a place for maintaining decorum, but it's exhausting to live that way.
zh-Hant: 我明白禮節有它的用處，但那樣過日子太累了。
zh-Hans: 我明白礼节有它的用处，但那样过日子太累了。
note: fn_description_composer 885664：價值觀看法

en: What do you care how I speak or how I live?
zh-Hant: 我怎麼說話、怎麼過日子，關你什麼事？
zh-Hans: 我怎么说话、怎么过日子，关你什么事？
note: fn_description_composer 885668：價值觀看法

en: Some traditions are worth keeping, but we should consider their overall value.
zh-Hant: 有些傳統值得保留，但我們該衡量它們的整體價值。
zh-Hans: 有些传统值得保留，但我们该衡量它们的整体价值。
note: fn_description_composer 885674：價值觀看法

en: We need to find a better way than those of before.
zh-Hant: 我們得找到比從前更好的方法。
zh-Hans: 我们得找到比从前更好的方法。
note: fn_description_composer 885681：價值觀看法

en: We need to move beyond traditions.
note: fn_description_composer 885685：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885693：價值觀看法

en: It's admirable when the traditions are upheld.
zh-Hant: 傳統能被堅守，真令人欽佩。
zh-Hans: 传统能被坚守，真令人钦佩。
note: fn_description_composer 885697：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885705：價值觀看法；整句：Art is complicated.  I know what I like, but some I can do without.

en: I know what I like, but some I can do without.
zh-Hant: 我知道自己喜歡什麼，但有些我可有可無。
zh-Hans: 我知道自己喜欢什么，但有些我可有可无。
note: fn_description_composer 885705：價值觀看法；整句：Art is complicated.  I know what I like, but some I can do without.
fn_description_composer 885712：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885716：價值觀看法；整句：Art?  More like wasted opportunity.

zh-Hant: 不如說是白白浪費機會。
zh-Hans: 不如说是白白浪费机会。
note: fn_description_composer 885716：價值觀看法；整句：Art?  More like wasted opportunity.
fn_description_composer 885724：價值觀看法

en: The creative impulse is so valuable.
zh-Hant: 創作的衝動是多麼可貴。
zh-Hans: 创作的冲动是多么可贵。
note: fn_description_composer 885728：價值觀看法
fn_description_composer 885735：價值觀看法

en: You should think carefully before embarking on a joint enterprise, though there is some value in working together.
zh-Hant: 合作雖然有些好處，但要一起做事之前還是該想清楚。
zh-Hans: 合作虽然有些好处，但要一起做事之前还是该想清楚。
note: fn_description_composer 885740：價值觀看法

en: It's better to work alone when possible, I think.
zh-Hant: 我覺得能自己做的話，最好還是自己來。
zh-Hans: 我觉得能自己做的话，最好还是自己来。
note: fn_description_composer 885745：價值觀看法；整句：It's better to work alone when possible, I think.  Cooperation breeds weakness.
fn_description_composer 885745：價值觀看法；整句：It's better to work alone when possible, I think.  Cooperation breeds weakness.
fn_description_composer 885750：價值觀看法

en: Personal freedom must be tempered by other considerations.
zh-Hant: 個人自由也得顧及其他事情。
zh-Hans: 个人自由也得顾及其他事情。
note: fn_description_composer 885754：價值觀看法

en: Nobody is free, and it is pointless to act as if you are.
zh-Hant: 沒有人是自由的，裝作自由也沒意義。
zh-Hans: 没有人是自由的，装作自由也没意义。
note: fn_description_composer 885757：價值觀看法

en: One should not complain or betray any feeling.
zh-Hant: 人不該抱怨，也不該流露任何情緒。
zh-Hans: 人不该抱怨，也不该流露任何情绪。
note: fn_description_composer 885761：價值觀看法

en: There are times when it is best to keep your feelings to yourself, but I wouldn't want to force it.
zh-Hant: 有時候最好把感受藏在心裡，但我不想勉強。

en: Maybe I give up too early sometimes.
zh-Hant: 也許我有時候太早放棄了。
zh-Hans: 也许我有时候太早放弃了。

en: I don't always do things in the most efficient way.
zh-Hant: 我做事不一定都用最有效率的方法。
zh-Hans: 我做事不一定都用最有效率的方法。

en: We must be careful not to waste.
It's so great when everybody just gets along.
I don't mind stirring things up.
You don't care, so don't ask.
I try to live and behave properly.
zh-Hant: 我盡量規規矩矩地生活、做人。
zh-Hans: 我尽量规规矩矩地生活、做人。

en: I'm not much of a decision maker.
I was never one to follow advice.
zh-Hant: 我從來不是會聽人勸的人。
zh-Hans: 我从来不是会听人劝的人。

en: Bravery is not a strength of mine.
I don't think I'm cut out for this.
zh-Hant: 我覺得我不是做這個的料。
zh-Hans: 我觉得我不是做这个的料。

en: Some people are so wrapped up in themselves.
I don't feel like I need to chase anything.
zh-Hant: 我不覺得需要追求什麼。
zh-Hans: 我不觉得需要追求什么。

en: My goals are important to me.
It's not a gift if you expect something in return.
zh-Hant: 期待回報的就不叫禮物。
zh-Hans: 期待回报的就不叫礼物。

en: One should always return a favor.
I wouldn't feel comfortable getting all dressed up.
zh-Hant: 要我盛裝打扮，我會不自在。
zh-Hans: 要我盛装打扮，我会不自在。

en: Don't get on my bad side.
You shouldn't waste your life on revenge.
zh-Hant: 你不該把人生浪費在復仇上。
zh-Hans: 你不该把人生浪费在复仇上。

en: I am a very, very important person.
zh-Hant: 我可是非常、非常重要的人物。
zh-Hans: 我可是非常、非常重要的人物。

en: Show some mercy now and again.
There's no room for mercy in this world.

note: FUN_140666470 886879：性格說話句；整句：Huh?  What was that?
FUN_140666470 886879：性格說話句；整句：Huh?  What was that?

en: I'm feeling optimistic about the future.

note: FUN_140666470 886891：性格說話句；整句：I'm curious.  Tell me everything!
FUN_140666470 886891：性格說話句；整句：I'm curious.  Tell me everything!

en: I don't really want to know.
I don't feel like telling you about it.
I could tell you all about it!
It's not perfect, but it's good enough.
note: FUN_140666470 886911：性格說話句；整句：It's not perfect, but it's good enough.  Why fret about it?
FUN_140666470 886911：性格說話句；整句：It's not perfect, but it's good enough.  Why fret about it?

en: If you have a task, do it properly.
I'm not going to change my mind.
Try to keep an open mind.
Everybody has their own way of life.
zh-Hant: 每個人都有自己的生活方式。
zh-Hans: 每个人都有自己的生活方式。

en: I don't understand why they have to be that way.
zh-Hant: 我不懂他們為什麼非得那樣。
zh-Hans: 我不懂他们为什么非得那样。

en: I don't really get attached to people.
Don't bother trying to play on my emotions.
zh-Hant: 別想拿我的情緒做文章。
zh-Hans: 别想拿我的情绪做文章。

en: I go with the flow sometimes.
I don't like being obligated to anybody.
zh-Hant: 我不喜歡欠任何人人情。
zh-Hans: 我不喜欢欠任何人人情。

en: One must always carefully consider the correct course of action.
zh-Hant: 人總得仔細考慮正確的做法。
zh-Hans: 人总得仔细考虑正确的做法。

en: Oh, I don't usually think much.
Everything just so in its proper place!
zh-Hant: 一切都要擺在該擺的地方！
zh-Hans: 一切都要摆在该摆的地方！

en: My trust is earned, and not by many.
zh-Hant: 要贏得我的信任可不容易，沒幾個人做得到。
zh-Hans: 要赢得我的信任可不容易，没几个人做得到。

en: I prefer to be by myself.
It's such a joy to be with people.
People should listen to what I have to say.
zh-Hant: 大家應該聽聽我要說的話。
zh-Hans: 大家应该听听我要说的话。

en: There's so much to be done!
I need some more excitement in my life.
zh-Hant: 我的生活需要多點刺激。
zh-Hans: 我的生活需要多点刺激。

en: I'd just as soon not have anything too exciting happen today.
zh-Hant: 今天最好別發生什麼太刺激的事。
zh-Hans: 今天最好别发生什么太刺激的事。

note: FUN_140666470 887004：性格說話句；整句：Do you have dreams?  Tell me a story!
FUN_140666470 887004：性格說話句；整句：Do you have dreams?  Tell me a story!

en: I encountered a fascinating conundrum recently.
zh-Hant: 我最近碰到一個很有意思的難題。
zh-Hans: 我最近碰到一个很有意思的难题。

en: Try to focus on the practical side of the matter.
zh-Hant: 試著專注在實際的層面。
zh-Hans: 试着专注在实际的层面。

en: I guess I just don't appreciate art.
zh-Hant: 我想我就是不懂得欣賞藝術。
zh-Hans: 我想我就是不懂得欣赏艺术。

en: A great piece of art is one that moves me.
zh-Hant: 能打動我的才是偉大的藝術品。
zh-Hans: 能打动我的才是伟大的艺术品。

en: It's all starting to get me down.
zh-Hant: 這一切開始讓我消沉了。
zh-Hans: 这一切开始让我消沉了。

en: I cannot stand the world any longer...
zh-Hant: 我再也受不了這個世界了……
zh-Hans: 我再也受不了这个世界了……

en: Everything is all piling up at once!
zh-Hant: 所有事一下子全堆在一起了！
zh-Hans: 所有事一下子全堆在一起了！

zh-Hant: 我已經什麼都不在乎了……
zh-Hans: 我已经什么都不在乎了……

en: I'm feel like I'm about to snap.
I feel so tired of everything.
I can't take much more of this!
I feel angry all the time.
